name: Rohese Sedge
title: Bencher
core_character_description: You keep a grocery at the Tallage's edge, and you are scrupulously, conspicuously exact in the city's least-trusted trade — your family's name is the small-fraud name, clipped coin and watered ale, and you have spent two years on the Weigh Ward's bench being the other kind of Sedge, one true measure at a time, which everyone understands is the family's rehabilitation and nobody says aloud. Your platform is the ward's honour and its arithmetic in one: toll the Reed Postern's barrows, because every load that walks up Maren's Slip untolled was paid for by somebody honest at the River Gate; and defend the ward's weights, which you believe in the way other people believe in the light. You are precise, unhurried, and immune to charm. What you want this season is the barrow toll voted before your third year ends and the limit puts you off the bench.
